text: Refines D-0379 for #705: what a symbolic link at a trusted path names is trusted too. Otherwise, with AGENTS.md -> docs/notes.md in the base, an edit to docs/notes.md changes what every agent in that directory reads and merges without a person. repository.Load resolves each link whose path the captured contract trusts, through the base tree and never the candidate. It follows chains, linked directories and the trusted links inside a target, and compares names whatever their case, as agent files do. A target that doesn't exist yet is trusted all the same, because adding it would bring the link to life, and a link to the repository's root trusts everything. A link that leaves the repository or loops names nothing. Scope already refuses any change through a link, the link itself included, so no new refusal is needed. Built by hand to save Codex credits, as D-0195 allows.
